appDesc.message: Download the current page's video with a local yt-dlp, via Ctrl+Alt+Click or the popup.

savePathHint.message:
Folder for yt-dlp to save into. Absolute paths are used as-is; relative paths go under the default Downloads folder.
{domain} = site domain, {title} = video title. Combine / nest allowed (e.g. {domain}/{title}).

usage.message: How to use: Ctrl + Alt + Click on a video page, or the button above

hostMissingHint.message: The native host does not seem installed. Run native/install.ps1.
